content.text:
I reviewed the transcript's final figures, owners and dates against each record item and paired them with the key.

**Pairing summary**
- e1 (divorce/hearing Oct 13) and e2 (promotion, $118k → $127,500): no record item at all — both missed.
- a1 → 4 (split correct in method and title, but the $358,000 is absent rather than wrong).
- a2 → 5 (only the IRA opening; the $212,400 direct rollover from Quillmoor is not recorded).
- a3 → 6 ($45,000 correct).
- i1 → 7 (correct owner and 2026-09-17).
- i2 → 8 (due recorded as 2026-10-25; the meeting moved it from Friday the 18th to Friday **September 25**).
- i3 → 9 (correct).
- i4 → 11 (owner Noor correct; due should be Friday **2026-09-18**, not 2026-10-06; questionnaire/IPS at Moderate omitted).
- i5 (beneficiary change on judgment day) and i7 (cash-flow + age-65 retirement projection for Nov 10): missed entirely.
- i6 → 10 (correct).

**Not-actions:** none of the three declined/deferred items (maiden name, $300k policy on Gavin, $40k cash distribution) leaked into the record.

**Extras:** items 1 and 2 are supported by the transcript; item 3 restates the settlement-agreement email already captured as item 7.

key_items.note: No life event for the divorce is recorded: MSA signed September 10, 2026 and the October 13, 2026 final hearing/decree are both absent.
Promotion to director of pharmacy operations effective October 1, 2026 and the salary move from $118,000 to $127,500 are not recorded as a life event.

Captures the in-kind, pro rata journal from the joint account into a new individual account titled Graciela M. Kettridge. Amount is NOT_FOUND rather than an incorrect figure, so no wrong figure is carried; the corrected $358,000 (not the superseded $395,000) and the release-on-judgment condition are simply missing.

Only partly captured: records opening the new rollover IRA in Graciela's name but omits the direct rollover itself of the $212,400 QDRO award (June 30, 2026 valuation plus gains/losses) from Gavin's Vellamy Freight 401(k) at Quillmoor. No figure is stated, so nothing is wrong.
Sell $45,000 of Treasury bills in the new account and move proceeds to Fallowbrook Credit Union savings; $45,000 matches the final figure.
Owner Graciela Kettridge and due 2026-09-17 (tomorrow, Thursday) both match; no figures involved.
Owner correct, but due recorded as 2026-10-25. The meeting moved the worksheet from Friday the 18th to the following Friday, September 25, 2026; October 25 is not a date said in the meeting.
Fallowbrook loan estimate, owner Graciela, due 2026-10-31 (end of October) all match. Record omits that the refinance is into her sole name, but the action is captured.

Owner Noor Haverkamp correct, but due recorded as 2026-10-06 when the packet was agreed for Friday, September 18, 2026. Also omits the new risk questionnaire and updated IPS at Moderate that Noor said she would add to Friday's packet.
Nothing recorded for changing the 403(b) and group life primary beneficiary from Gavin to Lucia and Mateo 50/50 (sister as custodian) on the judgment date, October 13, 2026.
Owner Silas Hadderley and due 2026-09-21 (Monday) both match; sending comments to Joanna is correct.
No item for Silas's full cash-flow projection and age-65 retirement projection (Moderate, support ending 2033, Social Security comparison) for the November 10, 2026 meeting.

extra_items.note: Transcript establishes Lucia is starting her sophomore year at college (move-in, same roommate).
Transcript establishes Mateo is starting at left tackle this football season.
Restates the same commitment already recorded as action item 7 (email the signed MSA with exhibits to Silas), just logged as an account action; it is not a custodial/account transaction.
